# gws recipe: Create a Slides presentation

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the task-recipe for creating a Google Slides presentation and sharing it with the team in 3 steps (create deck, get the presentation ID, share via Drive permissions). A recipe, not a reference: it complements `googleworkspace-cli-gws-slides` (the raw Slides API reference, lot 33) the same way lot 31 recipes complement their APIs — concrete flow, copyable commands, explicit `gws-slides` prerequisite. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); the `gws-drive` prerequisite comes from the same repo but is not listed in this catalog; install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
